👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `01dfe73`: all 26 files reviewed.

4 finding(s): 1 to fix, 3 to consider; 4 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 3.** I found one problem to fix in this part. The shade window is now loaded once and kept for the whole session, but unlike the overlay windows it has no `render-process-gone` handler. If its renderer crashes, every later countdown shows an empty window: no dim, no 3-2-1 and no REC border, until the app restarts, and nothing tells the user. The test named for the crash case only covers `destroy`, so it never exercises a crash. I also asked whether a reused shade can briefly show the previous take's frame, because the window is hidden before it is reset and shown again before the new state has painted. The new hide-main-window IPC, the overlay spare reuse and the engine's prepare/begin split looked consistent with the code around them. I only read the code; nothing was built or run.

**Batch 2 of 3.** Part 2 has no bugs and one question, posted at "consider" with low confidence. Takes are now acquired during the countdown, and the main window is hidden only when it ends. The renderer then waits a fixed 50 ms (`WINDOW_HIDE_SETTLE_MS`, recorder-store.ts:89) before encoding starts. That may not be enough to keep the app's window out of the first frame on every machine, and nothing would report it if it fails. The other new paths look right: cancel and discard during the countdown, re-acquiring when the input changes, the timeout, the new hide-window call, the spare overlay's handling of its first state, and the shade window waiting for state messages. The updated tests check what their names say.

**Batch 3 of 3.** Part 3 has no findings. I checked the reworked recorder-store tests against `recorder-store.ts` and they match it: the take is acquired during the countdown, re-acquired when `needsNewAcquisition` says the input changed, waits `WINDOW_HIDE_SETTLE_MS` before beginning, holds failures until the countdown ends, and releases everything on cancel. The two overlay test files match `parseOverlayQuery` and how `CaptureOverlay` handles a spare window. In `recording-pipeline.mdx`, the new 'Start sequence' section and the updated failure and cancel text describe the code accurately (`acquireDuringCountdown`, `startTake`, `hideAppForTake`, `beginTake`, `discardStart`). The test setup's `recordingHideMainWindow` default fits the tests that rely on it. I only read the code; I did not run the tests.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (11 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- New invoke `recording:hide-main-window`: main hides the main window and answers whether it was visible (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599`) — The main window leaves the screen when the countdown ends. The recorder waits WINDOW_HIDE_SETTLE_MS when the answer is true (recorder-store.ts:89, 388). If it fails: A rejected invoke is treated as 'was visible' (`catch(() => true)`, recorder-store.ts:388), so the recorder waits the extra 50 ms. The handler takes no renderer input. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599-604`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:650-653`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:381-388`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:413`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/preload/index.ts:135`.
- The shade window is prewarmed once and reused across takes; hide resets it to idle (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-shade-window.ts:57`) — `show` sends the region and phase, then calls showInactive. `onShown` releases the recorder's countdown wait (recording-hub.ts:546-551). If it fails: If the shade renderer crashes, the window stays with ready=true, and every later countdown shows an empty window for the rest of the session (reported as a finding). If ready-to-show never fires, the… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-shade-window.ts:134-195`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:655-670`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:540-554`.
- Overlay spares are keyed on the display set only; mode, intent and frame display are sent as state before show (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:404`) — A spare paints nothing until it receives its first state (`spare=1`), then shows the chosen mode. If it fails: A spare that crashes or fails to load is dropped by `dropSpareFor` (capture-overlay-windows.ts:657-666). A locale or theme change reloads the spares (screenshot-ipc.ts:82-87). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:684-701`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/screenshot-ipc.ts:80-88`.
- Acquire the take (session file, screen, mic, encoder, cursor track) during the countdown (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:266`) — The take starts about when the countdown ends instead of after roughly 1 s of 'Starting…'. The mic and screen are open (OS indicators on) during the countdown. If it fails: Cancel during counting calls discardStart: listeners stop, the engine is released once it resolves, the session file is aborted. If the engine fails during the countdown, onError records start.failur… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:398-408`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:453-459`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:525-546`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:577-598`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:658-666`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:330-335`.
- Ask main to hide the main window and report whether it was visible (recordingHideMainWindow) before recordingStart (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:380`) — The app window disappears when the countdown ends; encoding starts 50 ms later if the window had been visible. If it fails: A rejected invoke is treated as 'was visible', so the take waits the 50 ms margin. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:599-604`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/preload/index.ts:135`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:387-388`.
- System audio on/off is left out of needsNewAcquisition (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:355`) — Turning system audio on during the countdown takes effect without a second acquisition. If it fails: When no loopback is available, the forwarder sets the setting back to false. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:228-245`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:725-730`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:787-792`.
- A spare overlay (spare=1) paints nothing until main's first state, then latches the opened intent (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.tsx:101`) — A reused overlay shows the correct mode and intent from its first visible frame. If it fails: A spare that breaks is dropped, and the pick loads its own windows. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:231-251`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:646-650`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:686-691`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/screenshots/capture-overlay-windows.ts:512-518`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.tsx:145-170`.
- The recording shade window mounts with no URL state and waits for state messages (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/main.tsx:57`) — The preloaded shade is invisible until a take's countdown or recording state arrives. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording-shade/recording-shade.tsx:28-41`.
- Tests and docs describe acquiring the take during the countdown and beginning it at the countdown's end (prepareEngine → begin) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.test.ts:177`) — The bar's first tick is sent as soon as begin() resolves (recorder-store.ts:574-576), so 'Starting…' clears at the end of the countdown. This matches the docs at recording-pipeline.mdx:426-429 and 497-499. If it fails: If the acquisition fails during the countdown, the failure is held until the countdown ends. Then the beginTake catch block discards the start, reports errorStart with a retry, calls recordingStop an… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:232-254`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:311-344`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:517-598`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:456-458`.
- Cancelling during the countdown releases the prepared engine and aborts the session file (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.test.ts:726`) — The recorder returns to idle immediately. If it fails: An acquisition that settles after the cancel is still released: discardStart chains release onto start.engine, and the acquire step throws when pendingStart has changed (recorder-store.ts:434, 661). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:398-419`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:658-666`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:430-435`.
- A spare overlay window paints nothing until main sends its first state, then takes the mode, frame and intent from that state (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.test.tsx:214`) — The window stays empty until the state arrives, as the test at line 224 asserts. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.tsx:99-154`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/overlay-query.ts:41-45`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/overlay-query.ts:94`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/screenshots/overlay/capture-overlay.test.tsx:133-137`.
